item.name: Bakery
item.purpose: A shop location that houses the Baker, who sells ingredients.
item.cardSummary: Bakery is a milestone-gated ingredient shop near the plaza. Visit it after Baking level 3 to buy Baker stock for food boosts.

item.name: Fishmonger
item.mapPosition: In the plaza, opposite the Butcher.
item.purpose: A shop location that houses the Fishmonger Worker, who sells ingredients.
item.cardSummary: Fishmonger is the plaza ingredient shop opposite the Butcher. It unlocks through Frying level 3 and gives another shop source for boosted food planning.

item.name: Butcher
item.mapPosition: At the plaza, opposite the Fishmonger.
item.purpose: A shop location that houses the Butcher NPC, who sells ingredients.
item.servicesItems: Butcher ingredient stock and a Burger Stand.
item.relatedSystems: Ingredients, Chopping milestone, Burger Stand, Plaza.
item.cardSummary: Butcher is the plaza ingredient shop opposite the Fishmonger. It opens at Chopping level 3 and is also the location tied to the Burger Stand.

item.name: Supermarket
item.mapPosition: In the plaza, to the right of the Leaderboards.
item.purpose: A shop location that houses the Supermarket Worker, who sells ingredients.
item.cardSummary: Supermarket is the plaza ingredient shop beside the Leaderboards. It unlocks at Management level 3 and expands the shop route for ingredient buying.

item.name: Farm
item.mapPosition: Near the forest at the back of the map.
item.purpose: A shop and farming location where the Farmer sells ingredients and farm plots.
item.servicesItems: Farmer ingredient stock, farm plots, crop planting, and Instant Grow developer product access.
item.cardSummary: Farm is the back-map ingredient and crop location. It unlocks at Gardening level 3, sells Farmer stock, and connects directly to planting crops.

item.name: EKEA
item.purpose: A unique shop that sells Build Mode items from the current Furniture Pack instead of food-boosting ingredients.
item.servicesItems: Current Furniture Pack Build Mode items.
item.cardSummary: EKEA is the furniture-pack shop near the plaza. Use it for current Furniture Pack Build Mode items rather than normal ingredient shopping.

item.name: Event History Machine
item.mapPosition: In the plaza, by the Leaderboards.
item.purpose: A machine for viewing previous events and unlocking event items.
item.servicesItems: Two weekly offers that can be food or furniture.
item.relatedSystems: Event History, Food, Furniture, Diamonds, Plaza.
item.cardSummary: Event History Machine sits in the plaza by the Leaderboards. It is for past-event unlocks, but the location card should stay at machine-level scope rather than listing weekly offers.

item.name: Leaderboards
item.mapPosition: In the plaza, to the left of the Supermarket.
item.purpose: Boards that show the best-ranked players for specific Restaurant Tycoon 3 stats.
item.servicesItems: Cash, Days, and Customers leaderboard displays; Likes is a removed previous leaderboard.
item.cardSummary: Leaderboards are the plaza ranking boards for major stats such as Cash, Days, and Customers. Keep this row focused on the board location, not individual leaderboard entries.

item.name: Chef Luigi Statue
item.purpose: A Chef Luigi sculpture that can be used to learn more information about the next Rush Hour.
item.cardSummary: Chef Luigi Statue is a service landmark opposite the Playground. Its source-backed use is checking information about the next Rush Hour.

item.name: Plaza
item.mapPosition: Next to the Pier, at the front of the map.
item.purpose: The main hub that houses the Supermarket, Butcher, Fishmonger, and a fountain.
item.servicesItems: Access to most ingredient shops except the Farm and Bakery.
item.cardSummary: Plaza is the front-map hub for most ingredient shopping. It anchors the Supermarket, Butcher, Fishmonger, and nearby service landmarks.

item.name: Pier
item.mapPosition: Next to the plaza, at the front of the map.
item.purpose: A small hub that houses the Ice Cream Parlor and some boats; the source says it has no exact purpose yet.
item.servicesItems: Ice Cream Parlor access and boat scenery.
item.cardSummary: Pier is a front-map hub beside the plaza. It connects to the Ice Cream Parlor and boats, while its own page says it has no exact purpose yet.

item.name: Restaurant
item.purpose: Player-owned restaurant plots; each player runs one restaurant at a time during gameplay.
item.servicesItems: Restaurant saves, starting layout choice, cuisine choice, restaurant naming, info signs, and Build Mode customization.
item.unlockRequirement: Available when joining and choosing a restaurant plot.
item.relatedSystems: Build Mode, restaurant saves, restaurant info signs, gifts, likes, reports.
item.cardSummary: Restaurant covers the player-run plots. The page says there are eight restaurant plots, and each player runs one restaurant at a time.

item.name: Campsite
item.mapPosition: Next to the Farm, at the back of the map.
item.purpose: A minor location with harvestable mushrooms.
item.cardSummary: Campsite is a back-map landmark next to the Farm. Its practical source-backed use is harvesting mushrooms for food boosts.

item.name: Houses
item.mapPosition: Scattered around the map, typically around the plaza.
item.purpose: Decorative map buildings; the source says they do not have an exact purpose yet.
item.cardSummary: Houses are scenery buildings scattered around the map, often near the plaza. The wiki notes they have no exact purpose and no interiors.

item.name: Ice Cream Parlor
item.purpose: A pink-and-white landmark; the source says it currently has no use.
item.servicesItems: No current source-backed service; the page only suggests it could relate to an unlockable ice-cream stand in the future.
item.cardSummary: Ice Cream Parlor is on the Pier, but the source says it currently has no use. Treat any future ice-cream connection as unconfirmed until sourced.

item.name: Lighthouse
item.purpose: A red-and-white lighthouse building; the source says it does not have an exact purpose yet.
item.cardSummary: Lighthouse is a scenic building next to the Pier. Its page explicitly says it does not have an exact purpose yet.

item.name: Playground
item.purpose: An outdoor play area; the source says it has no exact purpose yet because the equipment cannot be ridden.
item.cardSummary: Playground is opposite the Chef Luigi Statue. The source describes it as a play area but says it has no exact purpose because players cannot ride the equipment.

item.name: Testing Baseplate
item.mapPosition: By the shop interiors, far away from the main map.
item.purpose: A changing developer test map visible from shop interiors with the `/freecam` command.
item.servicesItems: Historical test content, unused builds, Rig NPC, and developer testing context.
item.relatedSystems: Alpha map history, beta map history, shop interiors, testing.
item.cardSummary: Testing Baseplate is developer/history context rather than a normal travel stop. The wiki says it is visible through `/freecam` from shop interiors.
